title: Automation endpoints: one failure()/OK/ERROR on AutomationEndpoint instead of 89 hand-built error objects and 40 copied constants
definition-of-done:
1. AutomationEndpoint holds the only OK and ERROR constants and the only failure(String) in ixdar.automation; no endpoint builds an ok=false object by hand.
2. No private failure/failed helper remains in any endpoint.
3. Every route's response JSON is unchanged for the same request.
4. Full Java suite and the ixdar_automation_cli tests pass.
testing-plan:
1. Before and after, call a sample of routes (node-inspect with a missing path, mesh holes/topology/export failures, switch-model to a bad model, ring add refusal, inject-click, run-terminal-line) through ixdar-cli and diff the JSON.
2. uv run python -m unittest ixdar_automation_cli.test_cli.
changes-made: AutomationEndpoint now holds the only OK/ERROR constants plus static success() ({ok:true}, 34 callers) and failure(String) ({ok:false,error}). Removed 40 per-endpoint OK and 33 ERROR constants, the 8 private failure/failed copies (NodeInspect, Holes, Topology, Export, SwitchModel, ring Add, InjectKey, RunTerminalLine) and all 88 hand-built ok=false objects across 42 files; the 17 bare "ok"/"error" literals now use the constants (AutomationApiServer.writeError and ui/State too). Before/after probe of 56 requests on ring-tool and circle-canvas: every response has the same keys and values; 5 failure shapes changed key order only, because their extra key now comes after error: switch-model early failures {ok,outcome,error}->{ok,error,outcome}, fingerprint failure {algorithm,ok,error}->{ok,error,algorithm}, regions-not-built {activeTool,ok,error}->{ok,error,activeTool}, multiview framing failure {error,ok}->{ok,error}, mesh/dsl busy {ok,running,error}->{ok,error,running}. mvn test 539/0 failures; ixdar_automation_cli.test_cli 96 OK.
review-summary: Automation endpoints build their ok and error responses through one success() and failure() on AutomationEndpoint instead of hand-built objects and per-file constants. Every route keeps the same keys and values, so clients are unaffected.
